terms.definition: Agentic systems are AI frameworks designed to operate with high degrees of autonomy by breaking down complex, multi-step goals into sub-tasks without constant human intervention. These systems employ iterative reasoning loops, allowing the AI to use external tools, browse the web, or manipulate codebases to achieve a final objective independently.
terms.analogy: In a kitchen, a standard AI is a blender that performs one task when you press a button; an Agentic System is a professional Sous Chef who takes the instruction 'make dinner,' finds the ingredients, manages the stovetop, and adjusts the seasoning until the meal is complete.
terms.business_value: This shifts AI from a 'passive consultant' to an 'active employee,' enabling companies to automate end-to-end workflows in R&D and operations, drastically reducing the headcount required for repetitive digital labor.

terms.definition: This refers to the shifting cost structure of Large Language Model (LLM) usage, where 'tokens' represent the basic units of text processed or generated. DeepSeek’s drastic price reduction illustrates a race to the bottom in inference costs, making the processing of massive datasets economically viable for the first time.
terms.analogy: Imagine if a gallon of gasoline suddenly dropped from $4.00 to $0.12 overnight; the mechanics of your car haven't changed, but the cost of every delivery and commute in your business fleet has been effectively eliminated.
terms.business_value: Massive price drops enable 'token-hungry' applications—like real-time legal auditing or 24/7 autonomous coding—to move from expensive experiments to high-margin, scalable production environments.

terms.definition: AVD involves using specialized AI models to conduct deep semantic analysis of software code to identify security flaws or 'zero-day' exploits. Unlike legacy signature-based scanners, these models can understand complex logic and find critical bugs at a volume and speed that currently outpaces the human capacity to write and deploy patches.
terms.analogy: It is like having a car inspection sensor so sensitive it can detect a microscopic fracture inside a piston while the engine is running at 70 mph, but finding so many 'potential' failures that the mechanic cannot possibly fix them all before the next trip.
terms.business_value: While AVD hardens infrastructure, it creates a 'patching debt' crisis; executives must now pivot from 'finding bugs' to 'automated remediation' to prevent attackers from using the same AI tools to exploit newly discovered weaknesses.
